verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Sentry exposing its OWN MCP server (sentry-mcp) so external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, etc.) can call Sentry's tools — the reverse of this story, which asks whether Sentry itself can consume/plug in external MCP servers to use their tools (e.g., within Seer). No evidence shows Sentry acting as an MCP client or importing third-party MCP tool servers.
